BaseId.description: Identifies a warm base: the substrate a unit's home is cloned from.

CommitId.description: A Git object id in full, lowercase hexadecimal form.

Digest.description:
A content digest, lowercase hex. The algorithm is the fingerprint module's
choice; the model only fixes the form.

Platform.description:
A target triple, for example `aarch64-apple-darwin`. Part of the workspace
fingerprint, because a base built on one platform is not warm on another.

ProjectId.description: Identifies a project: one Git repository Nodal manages units for.

Timestamp.description: A UTC instant, serialised as an RFC 3339 string.

WorkspaceFp.description: The key a warm base is stored under.

description:
One base: a clean checkout with dependencies installed, keyed by the workspace
fingerprint it was built for. A unit's home is a copy-on-write clone of one of these.

commit.description: The commit the base was built at.

last_used.description: Last time a unit was materialised from it; the input to eviction.

path.description: Where the base lives on this host.

platform.description: The target triple it was built on; a base is not warm on another platform.

project_id.description: The project this base belongs to.

ws_fingerprint.description: The workspace fingerprint this base is warm for.

title: Base
